spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Within the outermost degree, the Divine appointed three fundamental supports, and fixed them within the external domains so that all later order could stand.

The first support was the full manifestation of Divine truth in a perfect human form, called forth by immediate Divine commission. It was established in the region where ultimates are arranged for governance, and it was extended so that the lowest degree could be opened upward into higher life, joining what is ultimate to what is inmost. By this extension it sustained the entire ordered whole and became the primary bearer through which all operative powers are held and carried. By its steadfastness the whole was made upright, and everything in every degree was held together and made firm, both what is interior and what is exterior.

The second support was an enlightened new natural degree, established above a natural degree that had been immersed in falsity and opposed to life. This higher natural was set in a way that it could restrain the lower, and in doing so it broke the closures and bindings by which a sufficient series of interior receptacles had been held in the intention of spiritual death. It instituted stability—stability made strong—over the falsified natural, and extended this ordering beyond it so that the lower could no longer rule. Thus it subdued, crushed, and permanently fixed the originating principle from which spiritual death took root.

These are the three fundamental supports, brought forth in confidence and set with honor in three distinct degrees within the same external domains. They were assigned and established in their proper places, and made immovable by the Divine will.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a single teaching about stability in ultimates through a triadic provision: first, Divine truth as universal support joining degrees; second, an enlightened natural restraining a falsified natural and breaking bindings of spiritual death; third, an implied but undescribed completion. The voice is consistent, though the absence of the third rock’s description creates a structural gap.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential incipit: sets up a triadic, functional teaching about supports in the ‘outer worlds’ without drifting into jurisdictional lists or rank administration.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by function and placement-as-support: “Three great rocks… were appointed… set in these outer worlds.” The spiritual reading reports no stumble here and naturally renders it as “three fundamental supports… fixed… within the external domains.” This is the substrate’s typical way of introducing a structural correspondence (supports in ultimates) rather than naming authorities over territories.

findings.diagnosis: Largely clean correspondential exposition of the first rock; any ‘administrative’ feel comes from titles (“Ambassador”) but the paragraph’s logic is functional (bearing, fastening, joining earth-to-heaven). No excision indicated.
findings.evidence: The paragraph’s teaching arises from what the rock does: “brought forth its base (?) from the earth to heaven. It bore up… the entire universe… weight-carriers… made fast every thing above and below.” This is classic correspondential functionality (support, fastening, vertical linkage). The one element that sounds like Mani’s administrative layer is the named office: “summoned… by the glorious Ambassador.” The spiritual reading had to gloss this as “immediate Divine commission,” signaling the name is not doing conceptual work inside the functional chain; but removing it is not necessary for narrative flow because the paragraph still reads as: first rock = Pillar/Perfect Man set upright sustaining all.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential teaching with one possible systematizing numeral (‘five storehouses’) that the reading could not specify, but it still functions organically as ‘bindings/receptacles of death’ being crushed by the new earth of light. This is a genuine difficulty, not a clear insertion.
findings.evidence: The paragraph remains functional throughout: the ‘new earth of light’ is defined by what it accomplishes against death: “squashed the fastenings… established firmness… flattened, crushed and fixed the root of death.” The spiritual reading explicitly notes the only strain: “‘Five storehouses of death’… exact content… not specified here.” That is a semantic opacity (we lack the referent list), but it does not introduce governance/territorial administration; it stays in the same action-logic (fastenings, firmness, root). Removing the ‘five’ would not heal a narrative seam; it would only reduce specificity.

findings.diagnosis: Structural gap / damaged omission: the summary asserts “three great rocks” but only two are described in the extant text. This is best explained as loss (or non-preservation) of a paragraph describing the third rock, rather than an administrative insertion.
findings.evidence: The text closes: “These are the three great rocks…” and reiterates triadic placement (“three… places”), yet the chapter only contains descriptions of the first and second rocks (¶3–¶4). The spiritual reading flags the stumble directly: “A third support is asserted but not described… structural gap.” This is not a voice-shift seam (no sudden jurisdictional lists, no new named authorities), but a missing member of an expected triad. The smoother narrative would come from reconstructing a lost ¶5 (not from excising ¶6, which is a normal resumptive conclusion).

textual_criticism.summary: 4 findings: (1) clean correspondential incipit (¶2); (2) first-rock exposition is function-driven with minor titular coloration but no disruptive overlay (¶3); (3) second-rock exposition is fully functional; ‘five storehouses’ is an unresolved referent but not an insertion (¶4); (4) the only real coherence problem is a likely loss/omission of the third-rock description before the concluding triadic recap (¶6). No passages warrant excision or annotation as administrative overlays in this excerpt.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: Three great rocks, which exist, were appointed by the greatness. They were set in these outer worlds.

So, the first rock is the [Pillar] of Glory, the Perfect Man, which was summoned [by the] glorious Ambassador. He set it in this zone; [and] brought forth its base (?) from the earth to heaven. It bore up under the [en]tire uni[verse], and became first of all the weight-carriers in [it]s powers. In its firmness it has been set upright, and has made fast every [t]hing above and below.

[The] second great and glorious rock is the new earth of light, which was set upon the earth of darkness. It has squashed the fastenings of the five storehouses of death. It has established firmness, with great firmness, over and beyond the earth of darkness. It has flattened, crushed and fixed the root of death.

[These] are the three great rocks, they that have come forth in great confidence, in three great and honoured places. They were appointed and distributed in three great places of these [self]same worlds. They were made fast according to the will of the greatness.

changes_summary: No changes made. All findings (1–4) recommended none; no paragraphs were targeted for excision, and no annotations were to be inserted into the text.
